title: The Secret Way Lakes Melt
description: Discover the hidden science behind how frozen lakes melt from the inside out, forming beautiful but dangerous candle ice before shattering instantly.
instagram_caption:
Spring ice doesn't melt—it rots. 🧊 Hidden beneath the surface, warm sunlight creates vertical needles called 'candle ice.' Watch how a single gust of wind turns a frozen lake into tinkling glass. 

#nature #science #lake #spring #satisfying

segments.narration: When spring arrives, a frozen lake doesn't actually melt from the top down. It secretly rots from the inside out.

segments.narration: As spring sunlight penetrates the ice, internal melting creates vertical, needle-like 'candle ice.' Though looking solid, it has zero structural strength.

segments.narration: But the real magic happens when a strong wind pushes these millions of ice candles to collision, tinkling like glass before instantly shattering.
